query: Write a bash one-liner that prints the ten largest files under the current directory, with their sizes.
result:
```bash
find . -type f -printf '%s\t%p\n' | sort -rn | head -n 10 | numfmt --to=iec --field=1 --delimiter=$'\t'
```

This prints the ten largest regular files under the current directory as apparent size and path, with sizes shown in K, M, or G. I haven't run it here.
